subsets.general-web: Page bodies, documentation and structured records; original categories retain finer detail
subsets.dynamic-sites: Content loaded after the initial response, including asynchronous requests and client-rendered records
subsets.popular-sites: Task-relevant stable content and qualifying named records or links on widely used websites
subsets.access-restrictions: Target content at URLs with previously observed access restrictions
subsets.embedded-documents: Complete document text, including embedded documents, tables and appendices
subsets.media-information: Requested image and video resources, links or metadata on webpages; media understanding is outside the task
subsets.direct-media-files: Complete delivered image and video files under the declared file contracts
subsets.articles: Article bodies, titles, requested initial comments and post collections; retained raw extension

subsets.scenarios-v1: Scenario queries with the first reference edition
subsets.scenarios-v2: The same scenario queries with qualified source-reference rules; not independent samples from v1
subsets.factual-v1: SimpleQA Verified retrieval tasks; the independently versioned derivative supplies the same selected questions

subsets.corrected-545: Frozen HTML with corrected reference Markdown and feature-scope annotations

subsets.factual-v1: Unchanged publisher questions of at most 128 Unicode code points, with reference answers and URLs

subsets.qualified-test: Source-qualified extraction tasks with unchanged upstream HTML and ground-truth text

subsets.curated-v1: Repository-curated fixed actions on public sites, with explicit programmatic assertions

subsets.human-qualified-v1: Eligible human-recorded tasks and fixed actions; a separate population from the other editions
subsets.corrected-90-v1: Historical corrected fixed-action inputs; qualification evidence retains its original external protocol
subsets.full-812-v1: Full task scope with portable and direct replay modes kept distinct; do not combine denominators across editions

subsets.scenario-specs: Driver-neutral scenario specifications; a separate population from executable task subsets
